description: Whether scripts/gate-local runs the gate preflight (scripts/lib/preflight.py gate, probes env.gate_preflight_probes) before it takes the gate lock, a slot or a worktree; a gap prints `FAIL env: <gap>` and the class line and exits 2 (GX-01, D-070). Off is the one-key rollback when a false positive blocks the gates of a machine.
